title: Staging runtime-persistence response-chunk schema repair authority

phases.objective: Allow the existing additive and idempotent 1048 response-chunk recovery migration to be planned through the Staging-only schema-repair authority for the runtime_persistence role without widening Production migration authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Prepare 1048_transport_response_chunk_schema_recovery.sql through staging_recovery_schema_repair_prepare on an exact main Staging deployment.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The server derives runtime_persistence, checksum, statement count, postconditions and typed confirmation; caller DB/raw SQL selection remains forbidden and the base Production contract stays dry-run-only.
steps: Resolve Migration 1048 through the Staging overlay and verify its canonical repository checksum and 34-statement contract.
Derive runtime_persistence as the target role with no caller-selected database or raw SQL.
Preserve the base runtime-bootstrap contract as dry-run-only verification authority outside the Staging overlay.
assertions: Migration 1048 is allowlisted only by the Staging readiness remediation overlay for apply_migration.
The derived target role is runtime_persistence.
The migration checksum is aecfbd9d87dca6eba11677cd992637f55ecf3c0743f704df4bbea48c57d8d788 and statement count is 34.
The Staging schema-repair plan retains raw_sql_allowed=false and caller_database_allowed=false.
